descFull: Open-source AI video platform: a self-hosted NVR (ONVIF/RTSP, recording, WebRTC) plus any AI model through one adapter contract, an app SDK and a catalog of ready-made apps. Offline-first, air-gapped capable, Home Assistant built in. AGPLv3. A Frigate / ZoneMinder alternative you can build on.
